story:
As a registered customer, I want to log in with my username and password so that I can access my account and shop.
Acceptance criteria:
- Valid credentials open the products page
- Invalid credentials show an error message
- Locked-out users cannot log in
- Username and password are both required

cases.title: Valid credentials open the products page
cases.preconditions: User has a registered account and is on the login page
cases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the products page

cases.title: Invalid credentials show an error message
cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter an invalid username or password
cases.expectedResult: An error message is shown and the user stays on login

cases.title: Locked-out users cannot log in
steps: Enter locked-out username and valid password
cases.expectedResult: A locked-out error is shown and access is denied

cases.title: Username and password are both required
cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
cases.expectedResult: Validation error indicates the missing required field
